en.basel-kadem: 4.	With this chain of narrators, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah, from Ibn Faddal, from a man, from Hafs bin Ghiyath, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: Openhandedness is a tree whose root is in  Paradise and which shades upon this world. The one who adheres to a branch of it will be drawn to Paradise.
